claim_label: Market deployment versus pre-deployment testing for AI safety
description: The entities disagree on the most effective methodology for ensuring AI safety. One argues that real-world deployment and market iteration are necessary to uncover vulnerabilities, while the other contends that the rapid scaling of systemic risks necessitates strict pre-deployment laboratory audits.

instances.assertion: Believes active deployment and market iteration is the only way to find and fix real-world vulnerabilities.
Believes advanced AI has systemic vulnerabilities that scale too fast for market corrections, requiring mandatory pre-deployment audits.
